biography: Fábio Sotto Mayor's journey began not on a racetrack, but amidst the vibrant chaos of São Paulo's karting scene. His father, a mechanic with a passion for speed, introduced him to the sport at the tender age of eight. Fábio’s early races were a baptism by fire, battling against older, more experienced kids on aging equipment. His breakthrough came at age 14, with a stunning victory at the Interlagos Karting Championship, showcasing his innate ability to wring every last ounce of performance from his machine. This victory caught the attention of several local racing teams, leading to his entry into the Copa Uno series. Although the transition was challenging, Fábio's persistence and adaptability shone through. Now at 21, he's making waves in the Fusca HC1 series, steadily climbing the ranks and aiming for the top step of the podium, proving himself a force to be reckoned with in Brazilian motorsport.
drivingStyle: Fábio's driving style is a blend of precision and calculated aggression. He is known for his late braking and smooth corner entries, prioritizing maintaining momentum throughout the turn. He excels at tire management, often conserving his rubber in the early stages of a race to unleash a devastating attack in the final laps. While not overtly flamboyant, Fábio's consistency and ability to perform under pressure make him a formidable competitor, especially in longer races.

rivalries.name: Ricardo Albuquerque
rivalries.reason: A fierce on-track rivalry stemming from numerous close calls and aggressive overtaking maneuvers in the Copa Uno series.

rivalries.name: Isabela Vieira
rivalries.reason: A strategic rivalry based on different driving styles and team strategies; Fábio often finds himself battling Isabela for crucial championship points.

rivalries.name: Marcelo Costa
rivalries.reason: A local rivalry originating from their karting days, now reignited as they compete in the Fusca HC1 series.

quirks: Always wears the same pair of lucky racing socks, washed or not.
Listens to a specific playlist of Brazilian samba music before every race to calm his nerves.
Draws a small cross on his steering wheel with a marker before each session.
famousQuote: Racing isn't just about speed; it's about making the right decisions at 200 kilometers per hour.
careerHighlight: Winning the 2022 Fusca HC1 race at Interlagos after starting from the back of the grid due to a qualifying penalty, showcasing his incredible overtaking ability.
careerLowPoint: Crashing out of the lead in the final lap of a Copa Uno race in 2021 due to a mechanical failure, costing him a potential championship victory.
